# Intent: <title>

Author: <name>. Status: draft.

## Problem

What is missing or wrong today, for whom, and how it shows. One paragraph, in the author's
words. Cite the spec, or the external contract, if one exists.

## Proposed outcome

What is true once this is done, stated as something observable. Not a design.

## Affected users and systems

Who notices the change. Which specs change status. Which Rocket.Chat features, settings,
packages or external systems are involved.

## Constraints

Rules that must hold: ADRs in `adr/`, the contract the package follows, settings or data
model that must not change, deadlines or product requirements.

## Open questions

Everything that has to be answered before this becomes a spec, one per bullet, numbered
`**Q1**`, `**Q2**`, … and never renumbered. An answered question is struck through and
points at where the answer went.
